names: net debt reads its cash at the filer's newest balance sheet (its newest Assets instant, us-gaap or ifrs-full), from the first cash alias that carries that instant in dollars, and every other line at that date; only where no alias carries it is the walk's latest cash read, within 180 days of it, and older is refused as a past balance sheet naming both dates; a combined annual figure withheld one IFRS year behind is worded for its pair
